field.title: Pin your field
field.intro: Satellites already watch every field. Just pin yours: Orbisol fetches NASA data for that spot.
field.tapHint: Tap the map or drag the pin to your field.
field.invalid: Enter a latitude from -90 to 90 and a longitude from -180 to 180.
field.mapError: Map could not load. You can still type coordinates or use GPS.

gpsError.unsupported: This device has no GPS access. Tap the map instead.
gpsError.denied: Location permission was denied. Tap the map or type coordinates.
gpsError.unavailable: Could not get your location. Tap the map instead.
gpsError.timeout: GPS took too long. Try again outdoors, or tap the map.

farm.intro: Your current rotation, canal turn, soil and top priorities.

season.title: This season vs normal
season.intro: Heat, rain, frost, soil moisture and greenness compared with past years.

rotations.title: Compare rotations
rotations.intro: Your existing rotation and two alternatives, with evidence, gaps and risks.

calendar.intro: When your field is bare and which months look vulnerable.

about.title: About Orbisol
about.what: Orbisol helps farmers explore crop rotation strategies using NASA Earth observations, local soil information, crop characteristics and their own priorities.
about.ai: Built with AI assistance (Claude by Anthropic) for code and documentation drafts. The idea and decisions are the author's.
